_about: Districts, places, and routes for the Explore map. Pins are fractions of the map image (0-1). Edit with Explore > Edit pins, then download places.json and replace this file. routes: walk/tram are minutes; estimate means the time is not printed on a map. Optional per route: walkRange/tramRange [min,max], goblin (minutes by goblin rooftop and tunnel routes, for the Runner view), source. districts[].atlas: pin on the City tab's PDA atlas art (x/y in percent), its label and note. districts[].dossier: the City tab's district dossier.

clock._about: Adyta time runs at real speed. At anchorReal it was anchorAdyta in Adyta.

travel._about: Places pinned on the city map (no district map yet) count as in their district; travel inside a district takes withinDistrictMinutes.

atlas.label: Low Halo
